suyi.binding_mode: suyi_refs on canonical politics regions/source nodes

asset_types.chapter_orientation: Locates a chapter and exposes its core problem and reasoning chain.
asset_types.nu_teaching_bridge: Connects the owning Chengfeng Natural Unit to prior/next knowledge without changing unit identity.
asset_types.compression: Reconstructs learned content into a small durable relation chain.
asset_types.repair_guidance: Routes wrong/uncertain evidence to the smallest sufficient owning source repair.

rules: Do not duplicate Chengfeng into an AI textbook.
Do not let Xiao1000 determine first-round unit order.
Do not expose Suyi as a second learner mainline by default.
Preserve canonical Natural Unit identities and source bindings.
Prefer content changes over hard-coded Astro political semantics.
Keep learner interaction low-friction and progressively disclosed.
